exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal, emergency cesarean, elective cesarean)
finding: CA-125 remains stable below 35 U/mL during pregnancy but increases significantly during vaginal delivery, slightly during emergency cesarean, and minimally during elective cesarean, decreasing postpartum with a half-life of 24 hours.
mod_finding: CA-125 increased markedly during vaginal delivery, to a minor degree during emergency cesarean section, and only slightly during elective cesarean section.
